visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-viewport-width photo hero with a dark overlay and left-aligned eyebrow, display H1, lead paragraph and two CTAs
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed background image, text overlaid left-aligned inside a 1200px content width
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed photo background with dark overlay; left-aligned white text: eyebrow tag pill, very large uppercase display h1, lead paragraph, filled primary button + ghost outline button.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: eyebrow paragraph, H1 title, lead paragraph, CTA links (bold link = primary button, italic link = secondary button)
rows: Eyebrow paragraph, H1, lead paragraph, CTA links
contentPattern.notes: The first picture in the block becomes the background, wherever it is authored. The paragraph directly before the heading is the eyebrow. Paragraphs containing only a link are grouped as the CTA row. Without an image the block renders as a plain text hero.

usage.description: Top-of-page hero on the WKND Adventures homepage.

reuseGuidance: Use for any page-opening hero with a full-bleed photograph behind overlaid heading text and CTAs.
